meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Codex 在编辑成功后若收到注释检查器的警告，会先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 当 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类操作成功后，检查器对改动发出警告时触发。

say.text: 帮我按刚才的检查反馈修复这条注释。
say.note: Codex 会读取阻塞性反馈并修改被标记的注释。

say.text: 这个注释为什么被检查器标记？
say.note: Codex 会解释警告原因后再继续。

say.text: 先解释这条注释，再继续改代码。
say.note: Codex 会说明被标记注释后继续后续工作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Codex receives comment-checker feedback after successful edit-like operations; if a warning is reported for a patch, it must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when comment-checker reports a warning after a successful apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit call.

say_en.text: Fix this comment according to the checker feedback.
say_en.note: Codex will update the flagged comment.

say_en.text: Why is this comment flagged by the checker?
say_en.note: Codex will explain the warning before continuing.
Codex will describe the flagged comment and resume.
